richiami.difetto: It has been identified that the risk exists that the rear shock absorber upper mounting may break. Should this occur control of the machine may be lost.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled machines will have the subject area inspected for cracks and reinforced if none are present. Should a crack be evident the complete frame will be changed.

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that the rear swing arm bolts may become loose or detach causing loss of control.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the swing arm bolts replaced and spacers with ocking clips fitted
